messages:
maria: Heads-up: master is red on gpu-integ after the dep bump from this morning. Failing in `kv_cache_integration_test` repeatedly.
ci-bot: build: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/ci/12345 – gpu-integ · failed · logs attached
maria: @ashok @samir can one of you bisect? I'm blocked on a release cut.
ashok: I can take a look. Any idea last-green commit? `master` was green around 1808860000 but not sure after deps bump.
samir: I ran a quick `git bisect` locally against the commit range that landed the bump, results look like it points to `0a1b2c3` (short) — KV cache refactor + dependency upgrade landed together.
maria: paste of failing snippet:
```
E tensorflow: AssertionError: expected KVCache.size == 128 but got 64
at tests/kv_cache_integration_test.cpp:142
```
ashok: hmm, that error smells like the refactor changed default cache sizing based on the new dep behavior. @maria can you try set env `KV_DEFAULT_SIZE=128` on CI and re-run one job?
maria: rerun kicked: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/ci/12346
ci-bot: re-run started (job 12346)
ci-bot: re-run finished — still failing
samir: bisect confirms `0a1b2c3` introduces the regression. Probably the cache init path differs when linked against newer libkv (v2.4).
judy: I can open a revert PR for the refactor while we debug. Any objections to reverting `0a1b2c3` as hotfix?
ashok: +1 from me, revert makes sense for release. Also we should open an issue to ensure compatibility tests with libkv v2.4 are added.
revert-bot: created PR: https://git.redwood-inference/internal/reverts/678 — Revert "kv cache init refactor" (author: samir)
maria: awesome. @judy can you coordinate the revert PR merge and backport to release/1.8?
judy: On it. I'll link the CI runs and add a note in the PR description with the bisect steps so we can reapply safely later. :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: triage tag applied: regression, revert-planned
maria: thanks all — feel free to @here if the revert merge needs manual approvals.
